relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: mice with diabetic neuropathy had decreased sirtuin 1 (SIRT1) deacetylase activity in foot skin, leading to reduced expression of brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF)

relationships.subject: SIRT1
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of SIRT1 in skin induced Meissner corpuscle reinnervation and regeneration, resulting in significant improvement of diabetic mechanical allodynia

key_findings: Skin keratinocyte SIRT1 loss reduces BDNF and Meissner corpuscle innervation in diabetic neuropathy
Skin SIRT1 overexpression improves diabetic mechanical allodynia
